name: streams
description: A stream reference the platform opens for a file address too.

CreateFromUri.comment: The platform opens such a reference only for http, https, ms-appx and ms-appdata: an address with the file scheme fails at OpenReadAsync with E_NOTIMPL, and an unpackaged application has no ms-appx. A file address gets a reference that opens the file when asked; any other address is the platform's.
